# Webumi

> Webumi (webumi.com.au) is an Australian web and AI studio for small businesses. It builds landing pages, business websites, apps (PWA, iOS and Android), custom platforms, automations and AI assistants. Run by Anna, an Australian sole trader (ABN 42 183 713 603). Works with clients Australia-wide, online.

Tagline: "More customers. Less admin." — Web, AI & Automation for Small Business.

## Who Webumi helps
- Tradies and home services: plumbers, electricians, builders, landscapers, cleaners, pool, pest control
- Beauty, hair, nails, massage and wellness
- Pet grooming and pet care
- Tutors, coaches, consultants and photographers
- Any Australian small business that wants more enquiries, online bookings or less admin

## Services and starting prices (AUD)
- Landing page — from $990: one page with one goal (calls, bookings or sign-ups), designed for phones, enquiry form with instant reply, Google Business Profile setup. Usually live in 1–2 weeks.
- Business website — from $2,490: up to 8 pages (extra pages $150 each), service and area pages for Google search, Google Business Profile and reviews. Usually live in 2–4 weeks.
- Website extras (fixed prices): online booking $490, payments & deposits $490, unique design, written text, stock or unique images, logo & brand kit $490, simple content editor or WordPress, CRM setup $490, smart quote form $290, online store $1,490, email marketing $290, Google reviews on the site $190, ads & conversion tracking $290, WhatsApp button $90, business email $150. Full price list and builder: https://webumi.com.au/pricing/
- Faster delivery: Rush +25% (about half the time) or Express +50% (landing page in 1–2 business days, website in 5 business days).
- App — web app (PWA) from $8,900; iOS & Android app from $14,900. Usually 6–12 weeks.
- Platform — from $15,000: client portals, dashboards, internal tools, marketplaces and SaaS products, starting with a focused first version (MVP). Usually 8–16 weeks.
- AI assistants and automations (Xero, Stripe, Gmail, Google Sheets, CRMs): quoted per project.
- Website fixes and redesigns: quoted after a free review.
- Support after launch: 30 days of free fixes, then Care $49/month, Care Plus $99/month or Growth $199/month (domain and hosting included, cancel anytime), or pay as you go at $95/hour.
- Free website planner: answer a few questions and get a plan with pages and a price at https://webumi.com.au/plan/

## How it works
1. Free 15-minute video call (anywhere in Australia) or 30-minute meeting in person (Sydney only).
2. A written plan with a fixed quote, within 1 business day. 50% deposit to start.
3. Kick-off, design preview and build with 2 rounds of changes, usually 2–4 weeks.
4. Launch (final 50%), 30-minute handover and 30 days of free fixes. The client owns everything — domain, website and accounts.
